posts.text: An analysis of tree-ring data from 1,200 fire-scarred trees suggests that the area of dry-conifer forest in New Mexico’s Jemez Mountains could be halved by 2055—a loss caused by mismanagement and wildfires made more destructive by climate change. In PNAS: https://ow.ly/GWrW50ZJsWv
